text: Imagine your customer planning a trip
with their AI assistant.
Your hotel gets recommended.
That’s a great moment to be
discovered. What if it could also
be a great moment to experience
your brand?
Right there in the conversation, your
rooms appear. Your photos.
Live prices. Dates they can choose.
They find what they want and
book—without starting over on another website.
Now imagine that same experience for
your catalogue. An order.
A seat selection.
A document upload.
Your business, ready to help when
the customer needs it.
Here's what happens behind the scenes.
The assistant calls Sail to check
live seats with your reservation system.
Your customer gets a branded seat
map, right in the chat.
They choose twelve A and confirm.
Sail sends the request to your
system, which checks availability again and
reserves the seat.
The airline confirms.
Sail returns that result, and the
same seat map updates.
Twelve A is theirs.
So when an AI assistant brings
your business into the conversation, you
can bring something useful to that moment.
Something unmistakably yours.
Something your customers will love.
